items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: When they got to Paris, Maude de Forrest, as some people do, lost her head.

ctx.x: Met her in Paris? I met Josephine before she ever went to Paris. I tell you how she happened to go to Paris. Josephine, when they had Shuffle Along -- Sissle and Blake had Shuffle Along. They had a little girl that stood on the end of the chorus line -- Josephine was on the end of the chorus line and used to clown and carry on, on the end of the chorus line before she heard of Paris, when she was a little kid like.

Josephine was only about 15 or 16 years old when she first went to Paris, you know, not a day older, very -- now, who was a wonderful singer, they sent for Maude de Forrest and several people, they sent to come to Paris. When they got to Paris, Maude de Forrest, as some people do, lost her head. She thought they couldn't do without her.
